_comment: Physical layout, in millimetres. diagram.json says what is connected; this file says where it physically sits. check_enclosure.js refuses to pass until every part has room, every port can see out, every part is actually held, and every shell is closed.

parts._why: lying flat on the floor, USB end against the front wall - the socket has to stay reachable with the lid on
the beak, standing on the shelf below: both transducers are flush with the front wall
sitting on top of the beak, lens turned from +z to -y so it looks forward through the wall
the voice, on the floor at the front-left: x90 turns the sound port to -y
x180 points the horn down, out through a slot in the floor
flat on the floor, right side

shelves._why: holds the sonar at eye height. Without it the beak is drawn in mid-air: it has to face the front wall, and it cannot stand on the floor and still clear the board

bosses._why: front-left, behind the buzzer and left of the board
right of the board, behind the beak shelf
